title: Table 3.9 Parking ratios: resident car parking minimum per dwelling
notes: Operative for A3.9.2. 'No minimum' across both columns, no bedroom split. Vol 2 had Location A 0.75 (1 bedroom) / 1 (2+ bedrooms) and Location B 1 / 1.25 bays per dwelling (C4P2-098, C4P2-099). LOCATION A: all land within 800 m of a train station on a high-frequency rail route (straight line from the pedestrian entry to the platform to any part of a lot); within 250 m of a high-frequency transit route, or multiple routes that combined have timed stops every 15 minutes in weekday peaks (7-9am and 5-7pm), measured in a straight line from any part of the route to any part of the lot; and/or within the defined boundaries of an activity centre. LOCATION B: not within Location A (C4P2-105, unchanged; the ToC's Perth and Peel limit is not in the text). No regional table.
